data.name: Humaidan
data.gender_notes: Humaidan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-d' which means to protect or guard. The name Humaidan is a masculine name that carries the significance of being a protector, defender or guardian. The name Humaidan carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humaidan usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Humaidan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humaidan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حميضان
in_arabic.meaning: هو منزلة مرفوعة بالحمد، أو منزلة مرتفعة بالحمد، أو منزلة عالية بالحمد
in_arabic.long_meaning: حميضان هو اسم علم يعني منزلة مرفوعة بالحمد أو منزلة مرتفعة بالحمد في الإسلام. يُعتبر هذا الاسم من أسماء الأشخاص التي تعكس قدرة الله على الخلق والرزق. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى منزلة الله تعالى. في الإسلام، يُعتبر الحمد من أعظم الأسماء الحسنى التي يُستخدمها الله تعالى. يُمكن أيضًا ترجمة هذا الاسم إلى منزلة عالية أو منزلة مرتفعة.

in_urdu.name: حمیضان

in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیضان کے معنی ہیں کہ وہ حمد اور شکریہ کے لیے ایک منزلت ہیں۔ یہ نام اسلام میں ایک مشہور نام ہے۔ یہ نام حمد اور شکریہ کے لیے مخصوص ہے اور یہ نام کسی بھی مسلمان کو دینے کے لیے بہت ہی شاندار ہے۔ یہ نام پاکستان میں بھی بہت مشہور ہے۔

data.cultural_impact: The name Humaidan carries a rich cultural heritage, as it is one that embodies the valor and bravery of the Muslim warriors of old. In Islamic history, there have been several individuals bearing this name who have made significant contributions as protectors and defenders of their people and faith. For instance, there was a famous companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), Humaid ibn Abu Halah, who was known for his bravery and military courage. He took part in several battles and was instrumental in the defence of Medina. Moreover, the name Humaidan continues to be used today as an Islamic name that parents might choose for their sons in the hopes of instilling a sense of responsibility and courage in them.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Humaidan is rooted in its present-day meaning as a protector or guardian, but it also carries deeper implications. In Islamic teachings, every individual is considered a trustee of their own actions and possesses the responsibility of safeguarding their own faith and morals. Furthermore, believers are encouraged to protect and defend the weak, the oppressed, and the vulnerable. thus, the name Humaidan can be seen as a constant reminder of this responsibility and a call to action for Muslims to uphold their God-given roles as guardians of their own souls, communities and indeed the wider world. Consequently, those with the name Humaidan may feel a deep sense of duty and responsibility to protect and defend the values and principles of their faith and community, and to make a positive impact on the world around them.
